frozen_selectors.safety_fixes_policy: Retain original result; label any source correction and rerun both development and held-out cohorts without changing briefs or scoring weights.

development_probes.intent: curved arch enclosing useful negative space

held_out.reveal_policy: Authors freeze machine-readable brief and expectation files before sending content to retrieval implementer. No indexed card names or paraphrase-only queries.
held_out.scope: Held-out authored composition briefs and spatial/connector combinations, not a prospectively unseen historical artwork corpus or blinded human preference.

arm_contracts.hand_typed: Finite generic side-elevation outline with a continuous four-cell bottom deck, two four-cell edge uprights and a four-cell top lintel in each supplied slot; no library or reference consultation.
arm_contracts.procedural_structure: Same slot bounds with four-cell top/bottom chords, two-cell vertical webs every16cells and alternating two-cell staircase diagonals; seed changes diagonal phase only.
arm_contracts.random_fitting_modules: Seeded uniform choice among structurally typed catalogue parts whose permitted transformed bounding box fits the slot, with current native observation and global material/budget/protection safety; ignores preferred motifs, target scales, reference scores and connector relationships. Host stage constraints still apply and refusals stay in denominator.
arm_contracts.reference_guided: Retrieve the same frozen reference corpus, then deterministic authored geometry strategy: open_span/suspended yields stepped arch shoulders and bottom deck; multi_level/vertical_chain yields offset supported shelves; other topology yields perimeter frame with sparse service webs. It does not select native modules or call a model.
arm_contracts.retrieval_guided: Use frozen joint part/pose retrieval, including preferred motifs, target scale, native observation, declared connector relationships and bounded search; native StagePlan rechecks exact geometry and guards.

shared_controls: Same source material plane, protected marker, anchors, region, allowed materials[0,7,28,58], intent/slot objectives, stage clearances, native/raster ceilings, and seeds per brief.
Native module pool is freshly built/harvested in the same harness process; importing stored flags is insufficient.
Actual changed/checked material counts may differ by tool geometry and must be reported, not artificially equated with quality.
Ordered input programs, source/query/corpus/module/program/plane SHA-256 identities and raw native receipts retained.
Every proposed, refused, cancelled, partial and completed case remains in the result population. No adaptive retries or arm replacement in confirmatory comparison.

metrics.interpretation: Constraint/tool-capability comparison. Structural contact and empty-space counts are geometric diagnostics, not proven load bearing, actor traversal, design beauty or language-model optimization.

evaluation_record_contract.authority: Actual native records and complete readback planes, never queued operations or rendered-only imagery.

brief_schema.anchors: rectangles [x,y,w,h,material] outside slot bounding boxes; source-native construction shared by all arms
brief_schema.required_empty_regions: rectangles within canvas; host stage must keep them empty, including authored negative space inside a slot when useful
brief_schema.expectations: separate hard constraints and reasoned architectural intent; no success prediction or preferred arm
brief_schema.author_guidance: Use up to4slots in256x192 with at least one feasible current catalogue part assignment. Include concrete asymmetry, negative space or aligned/misaligned connector demands. The brief may legitimately make some arm refuse; do not make all arms impossible.

prior_campaign: Original M3–M5 thirty attempts remain frozen: four contextual arms had identical output within each family/seed. This comparison neither rewrites nor retroactively improves that result.
